name: Namatanai
objection: Case for: the highway end point and base for Tabar/Tigak trips, a regional hub. Case against: one source with no listed sight, only services.

name: Boluminski Highway
objection: Strongest objection: a road is a journey not a place and the sights along it are separate; but both sources treat it as a Do, and it is a pin-able route at its midpoint.

name: Tabar Group
objection: Case for: a named island group, Karanas itinerary. Against: one source, 'minimal tourist traffic', no stated thing to see.

name: Lihir Group
objection: Against: mine island, little visitor infrastructure and the mine site is closed to the public; but two counted sources send visitors there and there is a scheduled flight.

name: Tanga Islands
objection: Against: no described attraction; for: named by the tourism board.

name: Tsoi Islands
objection: Against: no attraction described and no Wikipedia article; for: tourism board lists it and a guesthouse operates.

name: Laraibina Eel Sanctuary
objection: For: distinctive wildlife and culture stop. Against: one source, short visit, guided only, no location details.

name: Fissoa
objection: Against: one source and sits along the Boluminski Highway spot; for: named individually as a place to swim.

name: Deep Pete Wreck
objection: For: a named WWII wreck dive site, Kavieng's main draw is diving. Against: one source, accessible only to divers, appears only as a photo caption.

name: Tuluman Island
objection: For: the tourism board's own headline for Manus. Against: single source, boat-only, access unclear.

name: Lou Island
objection: Against: mining largely died out, one source, remote; for: it is the only named destination on the province page.

name: Buka Island
objection: Against: Wikivoyage lists services, not sights; it is mainly a hub.

name: Buka Passage
objection: Against: a boat ride (vehicle), and Sohano is the place at the end; for: the main listed activity.

name: Sohano Island
objection: Against: one source and a half-hour stop; for: it is the described destination of the Passage trip.

name: Buka Market
objection: Against: one source, short visit; for: daily market and the main thing to do in Buka town.

name: Wakunai
objection: For: two Wikivoyage mentions. Against: a village of services.

name: Mount Balbi
objection: Against: single source, multi-day guided trek, remote; for: the region's headline outdoor draw.

name: Mount Billy Mitchell
objection: For: Wikivoyage calls the lake beautiful. Against: a week-long extension, one source.

name: Yamamoto Bomber Wreck
objection: Against: one source and a short stop; for: a famous, signposted WWII site.

name: Nissan Island
objection: Against: very remote, no booking lines; for: it has accommodation and a named draw.

name: Carteret Islands
objection: Against: no facilities; sea-level-rise story but little to do; one source.

name: Buin
objection: Against: it is reached by a gravel track, one source, and the wreck is already its own spot.
